Chauncey, you were saying that Manny Klein had a style?
All his own. What were you saying about that?
No, you said he was a type - you said he would call out, you said he would call out what he wanted.
What do you mean by that?
Well while he was playing, he would be talking.
And what would he say when he was talking?
He'd say this is good for so and so.
Yeah. And then he would go into that.
